pattern: 数量 + は（すうりょう + は）
purpose: Emphasize that an amount is at least as large as stated.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
It takes at least twenty minutes to reach the station.
Let us prepare at least two liters of water.
There were at least a hundred people at the venue.
restrictions: Context can imply that the actual amount may be greater.
mistake: This is a lower bound; せいぜい gives an upper bound.

segments.role: Emphasize that an amount is at least as large as stated. Quantity + は + predicate
